links.outcome: Readability of chatbot responses on pediatric kidney stones (ARLC, ARI, SMOG grade levels)
links.effect: Google Gemini had the highest reading levels (ARLC 14.93, ARI 16.2, SMOG 13.32); readability differed significantly among chatbots (p < 0.001, eta2 = 0.195-0.512).
links.quote: Google Gemini demonstrated the highest reading levels across all metrics (ARLC: 14.93, ARI: 16.2, and SMOG: 13.32), whereas ChatGPT, Claude, and DeepSEEK produced less complex test (p < 0.001; large effect sizes, η2 = 0.195-0.512).

links.outcome: Reading level of LLM-generated patient education material relative to patient needs
links.effect: Google Gemini responses were consistently more complex and less accessible; its reading levels were ARLC 14.93, ARI 16.2, SMOG 13.32, with significant differences across chatbots.
links.quote: Although ChatGPT and Google Gemini provided more reliable information, Google Gemini's responses were consistently more complex and less accessible.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of four LLM chatbots answering standardized patient questions regarding pediatric kidney stones using readability metrics and quality/reliability assessment tools (EQIP, DISCERN).
